findings.evidence: Diff: `IsRestricted.add` changes from `simpa using (isRestricted_iff.mp hf).add ...` + `this.congr (fun s => by simp [map_add])` to `rw [add_zero] at h; exact h` (lines 147-153); `IsRestricted.neg` likewise (156-162); `isRestricted_zero` drops `simp only [map_zero]` (126-129). The PR description concedes "Three proofs do change".
findings.fix: Say the statements are AINTLIB's at weaker binders but the proofs were rewritten here to go through `isRestricted_iff_apply`, and that `IsRestricted`'s body now applies the coefficient function directly rather than via `MvPowerSeries.coeff`.
findings.issue: "Four further declarations are AINTLIB's, restated at weaker coefficient binders: ... `isRestricted_zero`, `IsRestricted.add` and `IsRestricted.neg` ... Their statements and proofs are otherwise unchanged." All three proofs are rewritten in this PR, and `IsRestricted`'s body is rewritten too — so AINTLIB is credited for proof text authored here.

findings.evidence: Line 111 `theorem isRestricted_iff_apply {k : ℕ} {M : Type*} [Zero M] [TopologicalSpace M]`; used at lines 150, 159, 173 where M carries `AddMonoid`/`AddGroup`/`Module R M`.
findings.fix: Reword to "the general unfolding lemma, at the definition's own binders (`[Zero M]`, `[TopologicalSpace M]`)", and keep the existing pointer that `isRestricted_iff` is the form to prefer once the coefficients are a semiring.
findings.issue: `isRestricted_iff_apply`'s docstring scopes it to "coefficients with no algebraic structure", but it is stated at `[Zero M]` and therefore applies to every coefficient type, including semirings; it is the lemma used inside this file at `[AddMonoid M]`, `[AddGroup M]` and `[Module R M]`.

findings.evidence: Lines 170-171: `theorem IsRestricted.const_smul {k : ℕ} {R M : Type*} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [TopologicalSpace M] [Module R M] [ContinuousConstSMul R M]`.
findings.fix: Say instead that `M` needs no multiplication of its own — only an `R`-module structure whose action is continuous in the vector variable (`ContinuousConstSMul R M`).
findings.issue: `IsRestricted.const_smul`'s docstring says "The scalar ring is unrelated to the coefficients' own structure", but the statement requires `[Module R M]`, which is exactly a relation between `R` and `M`'s additive structure.

summary: The new declarations are documented, but the Provenance paragraph claims three AINTLIB lemmas keep unchanged proofs when this PR rewrites all three, and two new docstrings misdescribe the hypotheses they are explaining.
